coverage.note: Shared translated algorithms, not identical source or a full-language/50-task claim.

method.cold_build: Fresh driver and compiler per sample; cache disabled. OS and installed-library caches retained. Source staging outside timer. Complete wall and native build phases retained.
method.runtime: Same Node/V8 and flags for both. test/run use official inputs/iterations/warmups. bounded retains production problem sizes with reduced counts recorded per case. Same state retained after warmup. Preparation, startup, engine compilation and output outside clock; no per-element host calls. Two Blot clock packet crossings versus two Goose scalar imports are part of their ABI costs. Common process wall includes parsing the Blot TypeScript guest host for both backends; it is not Goose's standalone runner startup score.
method.representation: Goose byte buffers use U8; Blot stores identical values in U32, 4x element payload bytes; owner and arena overhead are separate. Fixed backing capacities retained. Sort U32 values are nonnegative and preserve I32 ordering; ports restrict sizes to100000/400000, where exact integer RNG conversion matches every Goose F64 RNG state. Mandelbrot uses explicit ordered F32 in BOTH sources; original F64 remains unavailable. Fannkuch indices/permutations are nonnegative; U32 checksum wrap preserves final U32 accumulation. Wider parameter/clock plumbing stays outside kernels. Custom Hash::SHA256 is not cryptographic SHA-256.
method.ordering: Build phase sequential, then runtime phase; seeded paired shuffling, no deliberate concurrent measurement work.

change.intent: Reuse named helpers that access initialized source globals; carry only conservative transitive global footprints. Preserve full owner/effect contracts while sharing exact immutable input words and admitting concrete bound callbacks.
change.source_globals: Dependency-ordered initialization dominates exports. Source global roles are semantic inputs, not extra physical parameters. Actual references lazily allocate descriptor/ready locals; runtime guards preserve conditional first use. Mixed and inactive arguments never seed named global descriptors. Missing imports decline before initialization.
change.dependency_index: Cache source references and all associated candidates by spelling/operator, union actual callback bodies/captures, retain all globals for unknown/bounded metadata. Keys contain sorted global slots and persistent owner identity. Core retains associated/obligation names without executable projections.
change.transport: Normalize exact caller-local equality into structural key ordinals. Bind equal immutable words before nested planning, validate the complete body, and roll back/retry independent inputs if necessary. Completed physical demand selects the existing512-parameter limit; scalar results return exact bits through direct and packed calls.

--- a/src/world_storage.blot

@@ -428,12 +428,12 @@
     story: $tutorial.Access {state: story_state, supplies: story_supplies},
     research: $progression.Access {state: research_state, order: research_order},
   }
-  // The callbacks share one concrete bundle and capture only the owner record.
-  let hooks = $Hooks {
-    despawn: func id => return despawn base id,
-    reset_salt: func () => return reset_starting_salt base,
-    stash_scene: func () => return stash_scene base,
-    restore_scene: func () => return restore_scene base,
+  // One invocation environment serves every maintenance operation.
+  let hooks = $Hooks {invoke: func operation => return case operation of
+    $Despawn id => despawn base id
+    $ResetSalt => reset_starting_salt base
+    $StashScene => stash_scene base
+    $RestoreScene => restore_scene base
   }
   consume (@record.merge base {hooks})
   return ()
@@ -781,12 +781,13 @@
 const restore_scene = func access => return do:
   scene_history.restore_stash restore_scene_history access access.scene_stash
   return ()
-type Hooks is data = $Hooks {
-  despawn: U32 -> Unit ! {},
-  reset_salt: Unit -> Unit ! {},
-  stash_scene: Unit -> Unit ! {},
-  restore_scene: Unit -> Unit ! {},
-}
+type HookOperation is data = $Despawn U32 | $ResetSalt | $StashScene | $RestoreScene
+
+type Hooks is data = $Hooks {invoke: HookOperation -> Unit ! {}}
+const Hooks.despawn = func (hooks: Hooks) -> (id: U32): Unit => return hooks.invoke ($Despawn id)
+const Hooks.reset_salt = func (hooks: Hooks) -> (): Unit => return hooks.invoke $ResetSalt
+const Hooks.stash_scene = func (hooks: Hooks) -> (): Unit => return hooks.invoke $StashScene
+const Hooks.restore_scene = func (hooks: Hooks) -> (): Unit => return hooks.invoke $RestoreScene
 
 // Invocation-local aliases over independently named owners and frame buffers.
 // This invocation record introduces no persistent owner row.
